question: AIBA Women’s World Boxing Championships 2019 was hosted by:
solution: The correct answer is** __Russia.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • ​​​​​​The **2019 AIBA Women's World Boxing Championships** was place from October 3 to October 13 in Ulan-Ude, Russia. • Russia won the competition with six medals, followed by **China with five. **With 24 gold medals, Russia won the overall title in the **Women's World Boxing** Championships, making it the most successful country in the **event's history**. • The **Association Internationale de Boxe Amateur (AIBA)**, formerly known as the International Boxing Association (IBA), is an independent sports **organisation that regulates amateur **(Olympic-style) boxing competitions and bestows world and regional **championships.** • **India is currently ranked third overall in the AIBA Women's** World Boxing Championships medal standings. There are 32 medals in all, including **9 gold, 7 silver, and 16 gold ones.**​ • **Nikhat Zareer, a recent gold medal winner for India**, is the athlete. She won gold at the **2011 AIBA Junior** World Boxing Championships, making her a junior world champion in addition to her **2022 IBA Women's** **World Boxing Championship** gold title. ** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__** • ​​​Up until **2019, when the IOC discontinued **its accreditation of the federation, it was acknowledged by the** IOC as the world's governing organisation **for the sport of boxing. • The **IOC decided to suspend its recognition of AIBA** as the sport's regulatory organisation in June 2019, depriving AIBA of any connection to the Olympic Games. • A task team led by **Morinari Watanabe (JPN)**, the president of the International Gymnastics Federation, oversaw the qualification competitions and the **boxing competition at the 2020** Olympic Games. 101:T12b7,
